findings.title: Account UI message switched to Java MessageFormat
findings.body: error-invalid-multivalued-size in the account-ui bundle was changed from i18next placeholders ({{0}}, {{1}}, {{2}}) to Java MessageFormat, including a ChoiceFormat fragment {2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}. Every other string in this file uses {{ }} interpolation, and the account console translates with i18next, not MessageFormat. The validation error will show literal {0}/{1} and the choice pattern instead of the attribute name and limits. The embedded <values token can also be parsed as a tag if the string is rendered through i18next Trans, which this theme already uses for strings such as <0>{{username}}</0>.

findings.title: Admin UI message switched to Java MessageFormat
findings.body: error-invalid-multivalued-size in the admin-ui (keycloak.v2) bundle was changed from Attribute {{0}} must have at least {{1}} and at most {{2}} value(s). to a Java ChoiceFormat string. This file is consumed by the React admin console via i18next, which only interpolates {{ }} placeholders. Users will see the raw {0}, {1}, and {2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values} text, so the multivalued-size validation error no longer names the attribute or the limits. The Java MessageFormat version belongs only in the server theme bundles under themes/src/main/resources.

findings.title: Lithuanian account totpStep1 replaced with Italian
findings.body: totpStep1 in the Lithuanian account bundle was replaced with "Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:", which is Italian, not Lithuanian. The previous value was a Lithuanian instruction with FreeOTP/Play Store links. Lithuanian users setting up OTP will be shown Italian text. The new English source is "Install one of the following applications on your mobile:"; this line needs a Lithuanian translation of that sentence, not a copy from messages_it.

findings.title: Lithuanian login loginTotpStep1 replaced with Italian
findings.body: loginTotpStep1 in the Lithuanian login bundle was replaced with the Italian sentence "Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:". The previous value was Lithuanian. On the OTP setup page, lt locale users will see Italian instead of a translation of the English "Install one of the following applications on your mobile:".

findings.title: Simplified Chinese totpStep1 is Traditional Chinese
findings.body: totpStep1 in messages_zh_CN.properties was set to "在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一：". That is Traditional Chinese (手機, 安裝, 應用程式); the rest of this zh_CN file is Simplified (for example 手机, 配置的认证者). zh_CN users will see the wrong script on the account OTP setup step. It should be a Simplified rendering of "Install one of the following applications on your mobile", not a copy of the zh_TW string.

findings.title: Illegal-HTML diff trim can throw and abort the build
findings.body: When sanitized text differs from the message, the reporter trims a shared prefix (start) and shared suffix (end) and then calls value.substring(start, value.length() - end) and the same on sanitized. The loops do not stop when the two regions overlap, so start can be greater than length - end. That throws StringIndexOutOfBoundsException. A concrete case is value "aaa" and sanitized "aaaa" (or any insertion/deletion inside a run of identical characters): start and end both become 3 and substring(3, 0) throws. The exception is unchecked and is not turned into a messages entry, so the Maven plugin aborts with a stack trace and never reports which key had illegal HTML.

findings.title: Anchor mismatch message omits key and file
findings.body: When a translated anchor does not exactly match the English anchor, the verifier only records "Didn't find anchor tag " + the tag + " in original string". Unlike the illegal-HTML message, this includes neither the message key nor the properties path. The theme verifier scans every locale file; a CI failure then does not say which file or key introduced the href, so the anchor check cannot be acted on without rerunning under a debugger.
